candidate.title: irCLIP
candidate.scope: The middle poster row labeled irCLIP, from cellular RNA-protein complexes through an amplified cDNA library, interpreted at schematic scope using the 2016 Zarnegar et al. irCLIP implementation (infrared-CLIP). The upper eCLIP row, lower PAR-CLIP row and cropped CMCT chemical legend at the far right are separate visible context, with no arrows connecting them to irCLIP. They are not alternative target workflows for this single-row card. The IR800-biotin inset is an adapter component input, not an independent assay or branch. The leading row-description icon repeats the assay concept rather than adding an operation. No pooling, assay comparison, or unshown execution/analysis pipeline is added.

features: Final blue line is labeled cDNA; circularized cDNA supplies the PCR template and the resulting library is DNA.

Sequence mapping and RT-stop analysis are paper-supported interpretations; sequencing and computational analysis are not drawn operations.

operations.label: UV 254 nm crosslink lyse and fragment
operations.description: UV-C crosslinks RNA-protein contacts, and lysis/fragmentation produces a lysate of crosslinked complexes for immunoprecipitation. Specific nuclease trimming is represented separately after capture.
operations.mechanism: UV-induced covalent RNA-protein crosslinking preserves contact association through subsequent isolation.
operations.information_effect: RNA covalently attached to a contacting protein becomes the physical carrier of the interaction information.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate RNA-protein complex
operations.description: Captures crosslinked complexes through the protein of interest, changing the material from lysate to antibody/bead-associated complexes.
operations.mechanism: Protein-directed antibody immunoprecipitation on a solid support; the primary protocol specifies antibody-conjugated Protein G beads.
operations.information_effect: Introduces target-protein selection. RNA associated with captured complexes is retained; capture alone does not establish perfect specificity.

operations.label: RNase A and RNase I digestion
operations.description: Digests flanking RNA on the captured complexes to leave shorter protein-associated fragments. The source caption names both RNases; the primary paper compares nuclease choices separately, so a simultaneous two-enzyme treatment is not asserted.
operations.mechanism: On-bead nuclease cleavage of RNA around retained RNA-protein crosslinks. RNases are processing reagents, not material branches. The paper-supported clarification is recorded in c_nuclease.
operations.information_effect: Narrows the RNA carried forward to fragments surrounding the captured contact; fragment boundaries reflect digestion as well as protein association.

operations.label: Dephosphorylate and ligate 3′ adaptor
operations.description: Dephosphorylates nuclease-treated complexes and covalently attaches the IR800-biotin adapter to the RNA 3′ end while the RNA remains protein-crosslinked and bead-associated.
